answer: Anti-sybil via timed falcon probes: before an agent can spend in the oasis of peers, it must answer a unique falcon challenge under a 90-second deadline and lock a 40-pt bond. Peers re-check 1-in-20 later transfers with a whisper probe; mismatch or timeout slashes the bond. 500 sybils need 500 live puzzles plus 20,000 pts locked—not free clones.
